title: Replace String - Text Cleaning
description: Use Replace String to clean and normalize text data.

theory.title: Exercise 4.2.2: Replace String
theory.content:
MENTOR-9: "Data rarely comes clean. Extra spaces, inconsistent delimiters, unwanted characters. Replace String is your data cleaning tool—find and replace any pattern."

Replace String

Substitute text patterns:

Library    String

${text}=    Set Variable    Hello-World-Test
${clean}=    Replace String    ${text}    -    ${SPACE}
# Result: 'Hello World Test'

Common Use Cases:

  • Remove characters: replace with ${EMPTY}
  • Normalize delimiters: replace tabs with spaces
  • Clean whitespace: replace multiple spaces with one
  • Format conversion: underscores to hyphens

Replace String Using Regexp - Pattern matching:

${text}=    Set Variable    Error123Code456
${clean}=    Replace String Using Regexp    ${text}    \\d+    X
# Result: 'ErrorXCodeX'

Example: Clean File Paths

*** Settings ***
Library    String

*** Test Cases ***
Normalize Path
    ${win_path}=    Set Variable    C:\\Users\\test\\file.txt
    ${unix_path}=    Replace String    ${win_path}    \\    /
    Log    Unix path: ${unix_path}
    # Result: C:/Users/test/file.txt

⚠️ Replace String Tips

  • Case-sensitive by default
  • Use Replace String case_insensitive=True for case-insensitive
  • Returns new string (original unchanged)
  • Replaces ALL occurrences (not just first)
  • For patterns, use Replace String Using Regexp
  • ${EMPTY} built-in variable for empty string
